chanel-classico: A classic chin-length bob cut to one length all around, with the perimeter falling exactly at the chin in a clean horizontal line. Little to no layering; the ends are very slightly bevelled under for a smooth, rounded finish. Soft side part, gentle natural lift at the crown, sides falling close and even, and the back the same length as the front. Polished, neatly blow-dried finish with defined, healthy ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
long-bob: A long bob (lob) with the length falling right at the tops of the shoulders and a soft, nearly straight perimeter that is very slightly longer in front than in the back. Light, invisible long layers remove bulk only through the ends, so the hair moves naturally and rests on the shoulders without awkward flipping. Soft middle or slightly off-center part, natural volume at the crown, smooth sides. Effortless, polished blow-dry finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-de-bico: An A-line bob with a clear forward angle: the back sits at the middle of the neck and the perimeter slopes steadily downward toward the front, where the longest pieces reach just below the chin. Light graduation at the nape keeps the back neat and slightly rounded, while the front stays one length with clean, pointed ends below the chin. Side part, sleek sides falling forward, smooth polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-com-franja: A chin-length bob cut to one length in a clean horizontal line at the chin, paired with full, straight-across bangs that fall just at the eyebrows. The bangs are dense in the center and blend softly into the sides at the outer corners of the brows. No visible layers; the ends are lightly bevelled under. The rest of the hair is combed down smoothly with no part showing behind the fringe, sides falling evenly to the chin. Neat, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-repicado: A layered, choppy bob with the overall length between the jawline and the chin. Short-to-medium layers start around the cheekbones and run through the crown and back, creating lift and lots of movement. The ends are point-cut and slightly feathered, so the perimeter looks soft and piecey instead of blunt. Side part, airy volume at the crown, separated tousled pieces around the front. Light, effortless finish with clearly visible layering. Keep the natural hair texture.
long-bob-ondulado: A shoulder-length long bob styled with soft, loose beach waves. The cut has a gently textured perimeter at the shoulders with light long layers through the ends. The waves start around cheekbone level and flow down in relaxed, irregular S-bends, leaving the last few centimeters of the ends straighter and slightly piecey. Soft middle part, airy volume through the mid-lengths, natural undone movement with individual strands visible. Lightweight, touchable texture, never crunchy or overly defined.
chanel-invertido: An inverted, stacked bob: the nape is cut very short and closely graduated, with stacked layers building up into rounded volume at the back of the crown. From there the perimeter angles sharply downward toward the front, where the longest pieces reach the chin. The sides are smooth and fall forward along the jawline, with sharp, clean ends. Side part, lift at the crown, sleek front, and a defined stacked shape clearly visible from the side and back. Keep the natural hair texture.
long-bob-de-bico: An angled A-line long bob: the back sits around the base of the neck, and the perimeter slopes forward in one smooth diagonal line so the front pieces reach the collarbones. Mostly one length, with very light graduation in the back to keep it tidy and slightly rounded. Ends cut clean and gently pointed at the front. Side part or middle part, sleek sides falling forward, natural volume at the crown, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-longo: A longer bob that falls below the chin to mid-neck, cut in a nearly straight line with the front just a touch longer than the back. Minimal layering, only light internal texturizing to reduce weight; the ends are soft and slightly bevelled inward. Side part, smooth sides that swing freely, gentle natural volume at the crown. Classic, clean, polished finish with the perimeter clearly above the shoulders. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-curto: A short bob cut to the jawline, one length all around with a crisp horizontal perimeter sitting right at the jaw, slightly higher than a classic chin bob. Very light graduation at the nape so the back hugs the neck, minimal layering elsewhere. The ends are clean and blunt with a subtle inward bevel. Side part, sides falling straight along the jaw, natural lift at the crown, tidy polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-ondulado: A chin-length bob styled with soft, tousled waves. The cut is a lightly layered bob at the chin with a softly textured perimeter. Loose bends start near the cheekbones and move in irregular, relaxed S-shapes down to the ends, which stay a little straighter and piecey. Side part with extra lift at the crown, the waves adding width at the sides around the jawline. Natural, airy, lived-in texture with individual strands visible, not stiff or overly curled.
micro-bob: A micro bob cut very short, with the perimeter sitting just below the earlobes and well above the jawline, one length all around in a sharp, blunt line. The nape is neatly graduated close to the neck; the sides fall straight and partly cover the ears. Ends are crisp with slight texturizing so the shape stays light. Side part or middle part, sleek top with gentle lift, clean modern finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
long-bob-franja-cortina: A shoulder-length long bob with curtain bangs. The bangs are parted in the center, slightly shorter in the middle, and fall to cheekbone length, sweeping outward in soft curves that blend seamlessly into long layers around the jawline. The perimeter rests at the tops of the shoulders, soft and lightly textured, with light long layers through the ends. Middle part, airy root volume, smooth and bouncy blow-dry finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-franja-cortina: A chin-length bob with curtain bangs. The bangs are parted in the center, shortest in the middle just below the eyebrows, and grow longer toward the sides, curving outward to cheekbone length and blending into the bob. The perimeter is cut at the chin with a softly textured edge and subtle layers at the front for movement. Middle part, gentle lift at the crown, soft swingy blow-dry finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-italiano: A full-bodied Italian bob landing between the jawline and the top of the neck, cut with a heavy, solid perimeter and softly rounded edges. Only subtle internal layers create bounce while keeping the ends dense and thick. Deep side part with generous volume lifted at the root and swept to one side; the ends are bevelled gently inward and swing with weight. Glamorous, bouncy blow-dry finish with a luxurious, thick look. Keep the natural hair texture.
french-bob: A French bob cut short, with the perimeter between the earlobes and the jawline in a blunt but softly broken line, paired with a full, slightly textured fringe that falls at or just below the eyebrows. Light, almost invisible layering gives an undone, lived-in effect; the ends are a bit tousled rather than perfectly sleek. Little to no visible part, gentle natural volume, effortless, slightly messy Parisian finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-assimetrico: An asymmetrical bob with one side clearly longer than the other: the shorter side ends just below the earlobe, while the longer side sweeps down past the chin to the upper neck. The perimeter connects in a smooth diagonal line through a closely graduated nape. Deep side part on the short side, with a long side-swept front section falling across the forehead toward the long side. Sleek, sharp ends and a polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-franja-lateral: A chin-length bob with a long side-swept fringe. The bangs start from a deep side part, are cut on a soft diagonal from brow length on the short side to cheekbone length on the long side, and sweep across the forehead, blending into the sides. The bob perimeter is one length at the chin with a gentle inward bevel and light texturizing at the ends. Smooth crown with natural lift, soft and polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-texturizado: A textured, lived-in bob around chin length, cut with a razor and point-cutting so the perimeter is broken and soft, with wispy, separated ends. Internal texture is carved through the mid-lengths to remove weight, leaving a light, airy shape that moves freely. Slightly off-center part, messy tousled styling with piecey strands, a bit of root lift, and an undone, effortless finish rather than a smooth blow-dry. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-reto-polido: A sleek blunt bob cut in one heavy, razor-sharp horizontal line between the jaw and the chin, with zero layers and perfectly squared, dense ends. Styled pin-straight with a mirror-like glass finish: flat-ironed, smooth and very glossy, with no frizz or flyaways. Precise center part, hair falling flat and close along the sides, ends perfectly straight with no bevel or flip. Every strand lies neatly aligned while still looking like real individual hairs.
clavicut: A clavicut: a blunt, one-length long bob that falls exactly to the collarbones, cut straight across in a strong, full perimeter with no visible layers. The ends are thick and dense, resting softly on the collarbones. Middle part, hair falling smooth and straight down the front and sides, natural volume at the root, minimal styling with a clean, modern, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-nuca-raspada: A bob with a nape undercut: the hair at the lower back of the head, from the occipital bone down to the nape, is clipper-shaved very short in a clean, even section. The hair above is cut into a stacked bob, shorter in the back and angling longer toward the front where it reaches the chin, so the shaved nape is visible beneath the shorter back section. Side part, sleek front, crisp clean line between the shaved area and the longer hair. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-anos-90: A 90s-style bob cut between the chin and the jaw with a soft, slightly rounded perimeter and subtle long layers at the front that create chunky framing pieces. Styled with a big round-brush blow-out: lifted roots, smooth bouncy body, and ends turned gently under. Middle part, front sections swinging away from the center, one side tucked behind the ear. Glossy, voluminous, supermodel-inspired blow-dry with natural swing and movement.
micro-bob-franja-curtinha: A micro bob with baby bangs: the perimeter is cut bluntly just below the earlobes, one length all around with a neatly graduated nape. The fringe is short and straight, ending at mid-forehead well above the eyebrows, cut blunt with slightly softened, textured tips. No visible part, sides falling straight, a crisp graphic silhouette with light texture at the ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
chanel-de-bico-acentuado: A dramatic angled bob with a steep forward slope: the nape is cut very short and graduated close to the neck, and the perimeter drops in a sharp, straight diagonal so the front pieces reach the tops of the shoulders. The angle is clearly visible from the side, forming a concave line from back to front. The sides are sleek and fall forward, with clean, pointed ends. Side part, light volume at the crown, polished, edgy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-curvy: A curvy bob falling between the chin and mid-neck with a softly rounded, bevelled perimeter. The ends are cut with slight internal graduation so they curve inward in a smooth C-shape that hugs the jawline and neck all around. Polished round-brush finish with gentle body through the mid-lengths, smooth sides, side part, and a sculpted curved silhouette with no visible layers. Soft, glossy, rounded contour.
bob-graduado: A short graduated wedge bob: the back is cut in close, layered graduation that builds into a rounded, wedge-shaped volume at the occipital area and tapers tightly into the nape. The sides are short, ending around the earlobes, angled gently forward so the front pieces are slightly longer and fall near the jawline. Side-swept top with soft volume, smooth contoured finish with a clean, sculpted shape from every angle. Keep the natural hair texture.
cloud-bob: A cloud bob reaching between the base of the neck and the collarbones, with soft, rounded edges and gently blurred, diffused layers that remove heaviness and create an airy, pillowy shape. Styled with soft, loose bends and a light diffused finish, giving fluffy, weightless volume all around, especially at the crown and sides. No sharp lines anywhere: the perimeter is softly rounded and the ends curve gently. Middle or soft side part, bouncy, cushiony, touchable texture.
box-bob: A box bob: a thick, one-length bob cut bluntly at the chin with squared-off corners, so the silhouette reads as a full, boxy rectangle rather than a rounded or angled shape. No layers and no graduation; the back and front are the same length, with heavy, dense ends. The hair keeps natural width at the sides, middle part, minimal styling, ends left straight and blunt rather than bevelled, slightly undone modern finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
bubble-bob: A bubble bob at chin length with a fully rounded, voluminous silhouette. Soft internal layers build lift at the crown and fullness at the sides, and the ends are curled firmly under all around, creating a round, bouncy, ball-like shape. Side part, big glossy volume from root to ends, smooth surface with a springy, polished round-brush blow-dry finish.
long-bob-assimetrico: An asymmetrical long bob: the shorter side ends at the base of the neck, just above the shoulder, while the longer side falls past the shoulder to the collarbone. The perimeter connects in one smooth diagonal line across the back. Deep side part on the short side, with a long front section sweeping across toward the longer side. Sleek, straight-falling lengths and sharp, clean ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
long-bob-franja-reta: A shoulder-length long bob with full, blunt bangs. The fringe is cut straight across at eyebrow length, dense in the center and blending into the sides at the outer corners. The lengths fall to the tops of the shoulders in a mostly one-length line, with light long layers only at the ends for movement. No visible part behind the fringe, smooth sides, natural crown volume, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
birkin-bob: A Birkin bob: a soft, slightly shaggy bob falling between the chin and the middle of the neck, with a wispy, airy fringe that falls just below the eyebrows, cut with see-through feathered tips and opening slightly at the center. Light layers throughout give the lengths an undone, lived-in movement; the perimeter is soft and uneven rather than blunt. Middle part behind the fringe, tousled, effortless finish with natural separation between strands. Keep the natural hair texture.
butterfly-bob: A butterfly bob reaching between the base of the neck and the shoulders, with short layers starting around the cheekbones that blend into longer layers through the back, creating a wing-like effect at the front. Paired with soft curtain bangs parted in the center that sweep outward. Styled with a voluminous round-brush blow-dry: lifted crown, front layers flipped outward and away from the center, bouncy feathered ends. Airy, glamorous, full-bodied finish.
bob-pontas-para-fora: A flipped bob falling between the chin and mid-neck: a mostly one-length cut with light texturizing at the perimeter, styled so the ends flip outward and upward in a soft, even curl all around. Smooth, sleek lengths from root to just above the ends, then a playful outward flick. Side or middle part, gentle lift at the crown, glossy blow-dry finish with a modern, slightly undone flip.
bob-geometrico: A geometric precision bob with crisp, graphic lines. A heavy, perfectly straight fringe sits at eyebrow length and meets the sides at a sharp corner. The sides are cut in a straight diagonal line, from a short, closely tapered nape down to jaw-length points at the front, with no layers. Sleek, flat, ultra-smooth styling so every line reads clean and architectural, with a glossy finish and perfectly aligned strands.
bob-franja-bottleneck: A bob falling between the chin and the middle of the neck, paired with bottleneck bangs: a fringe that is short and narrow in the center, just below the eyebrows, opening slightly in the middle and curving outward and longer at the outer corners into cheekbone-length side pieces, shaped like the neck of a bottle. Light layers around the front and soft texturized ends add movement. Soft, airy blow-dry with gentle volume at the crown. Keep the natural hair texture.
bob-coreano: A Korean tassel-cut bob: a dense, one-length bob cut perfectly straight at the middle of the neck, with blunt, uniform ends like the edge of a tassel and no layers. Paired with see-through air bangs: a thin, wispy fringe at eyebrow length with small gaps between strands. Sleek, straight, glossy styling with the ends kept flat and even. Hair falls smooth and close along the sides, center part behind the fringe, clean and neat polished finish.
bob-wet-look: A chin-length bob styled in a sleek wet look: all the hair is combed straight back from the hairline with a glossy gel finish, lying close to the head on top and at the sides, with fine visible comb lines. The lengths fall behind the ears to chin-level ends at the back, slightly separated into wet-looking, defined strands. High-shine, glassy, editorial finish with no flyaways.
bob-shaggy: A shaggy bob ending between the jawline and the chin: the perimeter is soft, broken and piecey rather than blunt, with lots of choppy, razored layers starting at the cheekbones and running through the crown for rounded, tousled volume on top. A wispy curtain fringe falls just below the eyebrows and blends into short, feathered front layers. The ends flick slightly outward in different directions. Lived-in, undone, airy texture with separated pieces and a slightly messy, 1970s-inspired finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
